verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents policy-embedded card controls, real-time purchase review, and automated emails when memos or receipts are missing. It also offers real-time transaction webhooks and an MCP server that lets AI agents query and filter transactions. An external AI agent could therefore be built to flag anomalies, but there is no evidence of native AI-driven anomaly or out-of-policy detection that queues items for review. missing for 10: native AI anomaly detection, automatic out-of-policy flagging, a review queue for flagged transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
